c: With the plan complete, press Request Approval.
say: When the plan is complete, press request approval.

c: A normal change goes to Assess: its technical approvers are asked.
say: A normal change goes to assess, and its technical approvers are asked.

c: When they approve, press Request Approval again if shown: the manager or the CAB authorizes.
say: When they approve, press request approval again if it shows. It goes to authorize, for the manager or the change advisory board.

c: Approved, it moves on to be scheduled. The Approvers list shows every answer.
say: Once approved, it moves on to be scheduled. The approvers list shows who was asked and what they answered.

c: An emergency change goes straight to Authorize and the CAB.
say: An emergency change goes straight to authorize and the board.

c: Read the comments, fix the plan, Revert to New and ask again.
say: If it is rejected, read the comments, fix the plan, revert it to new, and request approval again.
